scripts.dev:fixed: bash -lc 'p=6333; if lsof -nP -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Port $p occupied:"; lsof -nP -iTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN; read -r -p "Stop process(es) and continue on $p? [y/N]: " a; if [ "$a" = "y" ] || [ "$a" = "Y" ]; then lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill -15; sleep 1; lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill -9; else echo "Aborted: port $p busy"; exit 1; fi; fi; npm run dev'
